name: Maiden☆Breeder
source:
Main character is a trainer of girls with beast ears called "maidens". He's limited in resources, so he needs to train them a few tricks fast so that they could bring money home soon.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名训练师，负责培养被称为“Maiden”的兽耳少女。手头资源有限，他必须尽快教会她们一些把戏，好让她们早日赚钱养家。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
